name: 3D Coordinate Grid Generation
aliases: Voxel Grid Sampling for Mesh Extraction
definition: Generates a 3D grid of sample points within a voxel space for SDF evaluation.
summary: 3D Coordinate Grid Generation constructs a regular lattice of 3D sample points within a specified spatial volume, explicitly handling 3D bounds and voxel centers rather than generating flattened 2D arrays or processing 2D slices independently.
